tree: View and analyze all your sales transactions.
View, search and analyze all your past sales in one place. Track transactions, see trends, find your best customers and understand what's driving your business growth.
Get detailed insights into your sales performance. See top products, best customers, peak hours and more to make data-driven decisions.
From retail stores to restaurants, salons and clinics — Noxtill's sales history helps all types of businesses track sales and gain valuable insights.
How Sales History works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business track and review historical POS sales?

Open Sales History in Noxtill to search the full POS transaction history, filter by date range and review trends and totals. It works as POS sales tracking software and supports the daily sales tracking POS teams use to close out each day.
How does Sales History software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

It shows what sells, when and to whom, so you can plan stock and staffing. When comparing sales history management for retail or point of sale sales reporting tools, check search and filters, trend charts, customer insights, refunds and exports.
